When we asked for a table, confirmed we did not have a reservation, we were directed to the forth floor. Another lengthy wait until another couple joined us in the room at another table. They lifted the menus that were left in the room by the waiter. He returned to inform us that one of our options was unavailable, then took the other couple’s order. Their drinks came immediately, followed quickly by their food order, which came in with our drinks. Our food followed some time after that.
